text: My granddaughter is 15 months and I don't know if I'm overreacting but something doesn't feel right. Her temperature is 39.1. She's got dark skin so it's hard to tell, but I think she's a bit greyish, and when I looked at her palms and the soles of her feet they look pale and kind of blotchy, and the inside of her lips looks paler than normal too. She also doesn't seem to want to bend her head forward. I tried getting her to look down at her tummy with a toy and she just wouldn't, she kept her head up and stiff and cried when I tried to help her. She was sick once earlier this evening but she's kept her drinks down since then. I've been up with her for hours, I'm not sure if I should be ringing an ambulance or what
